news.title: Health-related ballot measures more likely to pass
news.summary_en: As voters are increasingly asked to decide complex health policy questions at the ballot box, new research from the Brown School at Washington University in St. Louis finds that healthcare-related ballot measures draw more voters to the polls and are more likely to pass than other initiatives — but they’re also especially sensitive to opposition spending by special interest groups.

news.title: Lee named inaugural Selma and Herman Seldin Distinguished Professor of Medicine
news.summary_en: Janet S. Lee, MD, a physician-scientist in the Division of Pulmonary & Critical Care at WashU Medicine, is internationally recognized for groundbreaking research in acute lung injury.

news.title: WashU, AT&T partnership helps teachers use educational tech tools effectively
news.summary_en: The AT&T Digital Navigation Program, a free program offered through the WashU Institute for School Partnership, helped about 50 local educators learn how to use the right tools the right way.
